_doc: FMS P-51D Mustang 1450, docs/P51-STAGE1.md. Every band is the derived figure's (scripts/p51-derive.js) in the Kadet's and the Timber's proportions, never widened to pass.

p1_level_75.source: Re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 14 x 8 four blade curve (prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e, scripts/p51-derive.js through scripts/lib/propcurve.js): was 15.06 on the straight line, which under-read the thrust at speed; the band the same 0.880 to 1.120 of the derived (was 13.25 to 16.87) Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage: the pack's loaded voltage over the table's v_meas through the motor's law, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat), the stick now flown through the motor's own law (plant_wing.c prop_spool) where the derivation had flown it as the prop's speed share: derived 24.56, was 19.72; the same 0.880 to 1.120 of it (was 17.35 to 22.09).

p2_stall.source: Re-derived 2026-10-11: alphaStall over the wing's own slope, a_w 4.665 (scripts/p51-derive.js), not the wing and tail's 4.96: the stall angle is the wing's and the tail's share lifts on past it, as the Extra's (#935); was 0.21169. And the band with it: the plant's CLmax is the wing's 1.050 plus the tail's share at that angle, (CLa - a_w) sin a cos a = 0.064, so the formula's speeds go by sqrt(1.050 / 1.114) = 0.9708. Re-derived 2026-10-12 (w36-p51-clmax): CL max at the stall's own Reynolds number, the UIUC NACA 2415 and 64A010 on the strips' own terms (stall_re, scripts/p51-derive.js, docs/P51-STAGE1.md "The stall from measured sections"): the clean stall 1.0711 at Re 1.62e5, so derived 9.77 to 9.68 and alphaStall 0.22508 to 0.22906 (1.0686 over a_w 4.665, the gate's Re); the band the same 0.9396 to 1.1392 of the derived (was 9.18 to 11.13).

p2_stall_flaps.source: Re-derived 2026-10-11: alphaStall over the wing's own slope, a_w 4.665 (scripts/p51-derive.js), not the wing and tail's 4.96: the stall angle is the wing's and the tail's share lifts on past it, as the Extra's (#935); was 0.18528. And the band with it: the plant's CLmax is the wing's 1.502 plus the tail's share at that angle, (CLa - a_w) sin a cos a = 0.057, so the formula's speeds go by sqrt(1.502 / 1.558) = 0.9817. Re-derived 2026-10-12 (w36-p51-clmax): CL max at the stall's own Reynolds number, the UIUC NACA 2415 and 64A010 on the strips' own terms (stall_re, scripts/p51-derive.js, docs/P51-STAGE1.md "The stall from measured sections"): derived 8.26 to 8.25 and alphaStall 0.197 to 0.19803 at Re 1.38e5; the band the same 0.9395 to 1.1392 of the derived (was 7.76 to 9.41).

p4_top.source: Re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 14 x 8 four blade curve (prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e, scripts/p51-derive.js through scripts/lib/propcurve.js): was 20.64; the band the same 0.910 to 1.120 of the derived (was 18.78 to 23.12) Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage: the pack's loaded voltage over the table's v_meas through the motor's law, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat), the stick now flown through the motor's own law (plant_wing.c prop_spool) where the derivation had flown it as the prop's speed share: derived 30.79, was 26.6; the same 0.910 to 1.120 of it (was 24.2 to 29.8).

p4_gear_delta.source: Re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 14 x 8 four blade curve (prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e, scripts/p51-derive.js through scripts/lib/propcurve.js): the gear's drag costs more speed where the curve holds the thrust up, was 0.452; the band the same 0.44 to 1.77 of the derived (was 0.2 to 0.8) Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage: the pack's loaded voltage over the table's v_meas through the motor's law, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat), the stick now flown through the motor's own law (plant_wing.c prop_spool) where the derivation had flown it as the prop's speed share: derived 0.972, was 0.689; the same 0.435 to 1.771 of it (was 0.3 to 1.22).

p5_climb.source: full throttle, best over a sweep of airspeeds, derived 11.33 at 14.8 m/s. Re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 14 x 8 four blade curve (prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e, scripts/p51-derive.js through scripts/lib/propcurve.js): was 6.57 at 12.0 m/s; the band the same 0.750 to 1.250 of the derived (was 4.93 to 8.21), the sweep moved with the best climb speed, from 1 m/s under it (was 11 to 16) Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage: the pack's loaded voltage over the table's v_meas through the motor's law, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat), the stick now flown through the motor's own law (plant_wing.c prop_spool) where the derivation had flown it as the prop's speed share: at 16.74 m/s, derived 14.68, was 11.33; the same 0.750 to 1.250 of it (was 8.5 to 14.16).

p7_coast.source: Re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 14 x 8 four blade curve (prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e, scripts/p51-derive.js through scripts/lib/propcurve.js): from the higher top speed, was 17.10; the band the same 5.3 percent either way (was 16.2 to 18.0) Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage: the pack's loaded voltage over the table's v_meas through the motor's law, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat), the stick now flown through the motor's own law (plant_wing.c prop_spool) where the derivation had flown it as the prop's speed share: from the higher top speed, derived 24.28, was 21.47; the same 0.947 to 1.053 of it (was 20.34 to 22.6).

p9_phugoid.source: the phugoid root trimmed at the 75 percent speed. Re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 14 x 8 four blade curve (prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e, scripts/p51-derive.js through scripts/lib/propcurve.js): the trim speed rose from 15.06 to 19.72 m/s, was 11.44; the band the same 0.822 to 1.163 of the derived (was 9.40 to 13.30). The derivation trims at cm_0 0.0111 there; the plant's table still carries 0.0183, the old trim, until the lead lane writes it Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage: the pack's loaded voltage over the table's v_meas through the motor's law, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat), the stick now flown through the motor's own law (plant_wing.c prop_spool) where the derivation had flown it as the prop's speed share: the trim speed 19.72 to 24.56 m/s at cm_0 0.0077, zeta 0.541 to 0.691, derived 20.21, was 15.12; the same 0.821 to 1.163 of it (was 12.42 to 17.58). Re-posed the same day on the decay, the term found: the slipstream's pitching moment over the stabiliser (m_slip), left out of the trim until now, moved the plant's hands off trim 3 m/s under the derivation's; with it in (cm_0 0.0058) the plant trims hands off at 24.4 against 24.56. At zeta 0.691 the derived overshoot is 5 percent and no period is observable (the plant returns without crossing), so P9 judges what the root predicts, the envelope's e-folding time 1 / (zeta omega_n) = 3.363 s (p51:derive, phugoid e-folding; 3.74 at base), the same 0.821 to 1.163 of it the period band used: 2.76 to 3.91 s. The kick is the gate's 0.15 up for 1 s, which pitches the P-51 to 52 deg, past the linear mode; the decay is read from 2 s past the largest excursion.

p14_takeoff.source: Re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 14 x 8 four blade curve (prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e, scripts/p51-derive.js through scripts/lib/propcurve.js): the roll is shorter with the thrust held up to lift off, was 8.80 m; the distance band the same 0.75 to 1.5 of the derived (was 6.6 to 13.2), the speed unchanged Re-derived 2026-10-12 (w36-p51-clmax): CL max at the stall's own Reynolds number, the UIUC NACA 2415 and 64A010 on the strips' own terms (stall_re, scripts/p51-derive.js, docs/P51-STAGE1.md "The stall from measured sections"): the rotation at 1.1 Vs moves with Vs (10.06 to 9.96 by the formula), the roll 6.50 to 6.51 m; the distance band the same 0.75 to 1.5 of the derived (was 4.88 to 9.75), the speed unchanged. Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage: the pack's loaded voltage over the table's v_meas through the motor's law, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat), the stick now flown through the motor's own law (plant_wing.c prop_spool) where the derivation had flown it as the prop's speed share: the roll derived 5.415, was 6.51; the same 0.750 to 1.501 of it (was 4.88 to 9.77).

p18_landing.source: glidePathDeg: the stabilized approach's glide path, "typically a constant 3 degrees to the touchdown zone" (FAA-H-8083-3C ch. 9), was a 4 deg sink rate held on unsourced throttle gains. z0 10 removed: the approach now starts where the handbook's stabilized approach criteria apply, 500 ft above the runway at the model's 1:7.8 (19.5 m, derived in the gate). maxTouchSpeed and pitchTolDeg unchanged. Re-derived 2026-10-12 (w36-p51-clmax): CL max at the stall's own Reynolds number, the UIUC NACA 2415 and 64A010 on the strips' own terms (stall_re, scripts/p51-derive.js, docs/P51-STAGE1.md "The stall from measured sections"): approach is 1.3 Vs with full flap, 1.3 x 8.40 = 10.92 (was 1.3 x 8.41 = 10.94).
